items.title: Thomas Andrew Dorsey Interview, 1980-08-06
items.q: Interviewer lists Janice Jones as one of the top five divas... Interviewee previously confirmed 'Yeah, I knew' regarding Bessie Griffin, implying general knowledge of the group rather than a specific personal relationship with Janice Jones.

ctx.x: Did you know a New Orleans gospel singer, Bessie Griffin? Bessie Griffin? Yeah, I knew. Is she still living?

Yeah, she's in California, out in Los Angeles now. Oh, she's out in Los Angeles. Remember she came to Chicago, remember Mahalia brought her to Chicago, and remember when we had the convention there in Chicago, Mahalia called, there were four great black gospel singers, women. One was Willa May Ford Smith, one was Bessie Griffin, one was Janice Jones, Ernestine Washington out of New York, and Mahalia. They were the top five divas of gospel music in the early days, and she was one of those. She was one of those.
She was one of those. Yeah. Did you see anything in similarity between Mahalia style and Bessie Griffin style at the time?
